note: Expanded benchmark via benchmarks/expand_ramachandran_benchmark.py. Candidates drawn by seeded era-representative sampling across the full RCSB result range per bin. See the *_comparison.csv for the per-structure data.
chain_id_fix: chain_map remapping applied to _cif_to_pdb (A-Z then 0-9; structures with >36 distinct chains are skipped as 'too_many_chains'). This run supersedes the prior 279-struct run for mmCIF-converted entries with multi-character chain IDs.
pearson_outlier_note: Pearson r is dominated by a single anomalous wwPDB entry, 5M2K (wwPDB=100.0%, ChiralFold=0.0%). Excluding it: Pearson r=0.853, Spearman rho=0.521 (n=362). Spearman (rank-based) is robust to this point; the headline Pearson r=0.330 reflects its outlier sensitivity, not a weaker relationship.
exclusion_criterion: Structures with wwpdb_rama_outlier_pct > 50.0% are excluded as non-standard entries (typically pure nucleic acids or degenerate cases with <5 analyzable protein residues). Ramachandran analysis is only meaningful for standard protein backbones; such entries are not the intended benchmark target. In this dataset the sole exclusion is 5M2K, the crystal structure of vancomycin (a 7-monomer glycopeptide antibiotic with only 2 standard amino-acid residues), which wwPDB scores at 100% Ramachandran outliers.
